parsed.change_summary: Changed the format specifier from %x to %u in the printf statement to prevent format string injection.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the format specifier %x has been changed to %u. The %u specifier is used for printing unsigned integers, which does not interpret the input as a format string. This prevents an attacker from injecting format specifiers and executing arbitrary code.
